assumptions.strategyDividends: Cash dividends credited at ex-date for preceding-close holdings; taxes and payment delay excluded.
assumptions.priceBasis: Close is ETF price return; adjusted is ETF return including reinvested distributions. Select the basis consistent with the strategy dividend scenario.
assumptions.fixedHalf: 50% ETF and 50% cash, rebalanced at every close. A fixed allocation chosen before examining results.
assumptions.matchedAverage: Constant ETF weight equal to strategy mean invested fraction over the matching return intervals. Retrospective exposure diagnostic.
assumptions.laggedExposure: ETF return during each close-to-close interval multiplied by strategy invested fraction at the preceding close. Retrospective strategy-dependent timing diagnostic.
assumptions.referenceCosts: ETF rebalancing costs excluded, making these optimistic reference returns. Strategy retains actual modeled fees and slippage.
limitations: Dividend scenario credits stock distributions on ex-date rather than payment date.
Mean exposure does not equal matched volatility or matched factor exposure.
Lagged exposure uses preceding-close holdings; portfolio may trade at next open.
